name: Villazala (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green with a red triangle with its base along the hoist, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villazala (a bell, a tower and a lion on green).
history: Municipal flag of Villazala; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
Villazala arms — bell, tower and lion on green
crown and bell of the arms
